text: To identify something is to figure out exactly what it is. Scientists identified the tilcayo as a new kind of cat.
To compare is to look at things side by side to see how they are alike and different. The scientists compared Tigrino with other wild cats.
To protect something is to keep it safe from harm. People want to keep wild cats safe.
The Andes are a very long chain of tall mountains in South America.
Mountains are very high lands that rise far above the ground around them.
A tilcayo is a tiny wild cat. Say it TIL-ky-oh. It is a newly found kind of cat.
Scientists are people who study the world to learn how things work.
A study is a careful project to learn something new. Scientists write down what they find.
Current Biology is a magazine where scientists share what they have learned about living things.
A species is one kind of living thing. All house cats are one species.
Wild animals live in nature on their own. They are not pets.
Senda Verde is a place where hurt or lost wild animals are cared for.
A sanctuary is a safe place for animals. People there take care of them.
Bolivia is a country in South America. The Andes mountains run through it.
Tigrino is the name of the tilcayo that lives at the sanctuary.
Keepers are the people who feed and care for animals.
An oncilla is a small wild cat with spots. It lives in Central and South America.
Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz is the scientist who first noticed that Tigrino was different.
What something weighs is how heavy it is. A pound is a way to measure weight.
Spots are small round marks on an animal's fur.
DNA is like a tiny instruction book inside every living thing. It helps decide how a body looks and grows.
To realize something is to suddenly understand it.
To cofound something is to start it together with another person.
The Associated Press is a company whose reporters write news stories.
An ambassador is someone who speaks up for a cause. Tigrino helps people learn about wild cats.
Conservation means taking care of nature so animals and plants stay safe.
Awareness is knowing about something. Raising awareness means helping more people learn about it.
The author is the person who wrote the story.
To quote someone is to repeat the exact words that person said.
